note: 0.1.16 second review: standing_words_re keeps only clear standing phrases (don't ask again, no need to ask, feel free to, from now on, without asking, the whole word standing, until further notice/I say so, whenever/any time you want/need) and no match after not/don't/never/no within three words; V1 until, V3 negation, V4 long-standing, V5 whenever-one-time and V6 always read once; four real phrases still read standing. A gate is allowed only when the user's own words name every gate of the line, a protected branch by name (V2: push words never cover a production deploy). Denials count over every session on the own line from the writer to the reader (B between A and C), and an unreadable transcript on that line allows no gate (denied_unread).
